headline: Argentina Supreme Court strikes down healthcare fee deregulation
summary: Argentina's Supreme Court ruled unconstitutional the deregulation of private health insurance fees, restoring regulatory oversight by the Superintendencia de Servicios de Salud.
why: Private health insurance providers in Argentina face strict price regulation following court interventions.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Judicial ruling re-imposes state price controls on domestic healthcare providers.
